high_yield: Duloxetine is the only SNRI with FDA pediatric approval, indicated specifically for Generalized Anxiety Disorder in ages 7-17 (Dulcan p.743, StahlKids p.171).
Bupropion is strictly contraindicated in patients with anorexia or bulimia due to a dose-dependent seizure risk (Dulcan p.718, StahlKids p.85).
Venlafaxine carries the highest signal for treatment-emergent activation and suicidality in pediatric clinical trials compared to other antidepressants (Dulcan p.226, Dulcan p.751).
Trazodone can cause priapism in male adolescents, which is a urological emergency (Dulcan p.750, StahlKids p.453).
California Rocket Fuel is the synergistic combination of an SNRI (e.g., Venlafaxine) with Mirtazapine, utilizing reuptake blockade and alpha-2 antagonism (StahlNeuro p.308, StahlNeuro p.310).
